title: Point spread function requirements for dark matter subhalo detection with the Habitable Worlds Observatory
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to RAS Techniques and Instruments
summary: Different theories of dark matter predict different populations and morphologies of galactic subhaloes below about $10^8M_{\odot}$. The planned angular resolution and optical stability of the Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO) should enable it to detect subtle subhalo perturbations in strongly lensed galaxy images. We simulate 2000-second exposures with its High Resolution Imager (HRI) under the fiducial Exploratory Analytic Case 1 (EAC1) design, assuming known source structure and omitting lens-galaxy light. Pre-selecting the top 50 of 965 lenses (5.2%) using only arc signal-to-noise and relative gradient power lowers the median mass threshold for 10% aperture coverage roughly tenfold relative to the full ensemble. The top 12 (1.2%) reach a median of $6.6\times10^7M_{\odot}$ for the same coverage. At their most sensitive positions, the top 50 and top 12 reach median thresholds of $3\times10^7M_{\odot}$ and $1.5\times10^7M_{\odot}$, respectively. Non-linear fits support the Fisher forecasts at the tested masses and positions. For these 12 lenses, increasing the physical wavefront error from 35 to 65 nm RMS raises the median thresholds by only 0.1 dex when the point spread function (PSF) is modelled correctly. Deliberately mismodelling the 35-nm reference PSF removes detectable positions, although false detections remain rare. Under our illustrative retention criteria, loss of sensitive area sets a median tolerated wavefront mismatch of 5 nm RMS (range 2--10 nm). Selective HWO follow-up of lenses discovered by Euclid or Roman could therefore transform our understanding of the nature of dark matter, provided that the PSF is characterized accurately enough to preserve this sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过模拟HWO高分辨率成像仪对强透镜星系图像的观测，评估其对暗物质子晕的探测能力，发现预选优质透镜可将质量探测阈值降低约十倍，且PSF表征精度是保持该灵敏度的关键。
AI.motivation: 不同暗物质理论预测了约10^8太阳质量以下星系子晕的种群和形态差异，而探测这些子晕有助于理解暗物质本质。HWO计划中的角分辨率和光学稳定性有望探测强透镜星系图像中的细微子晕扰动，因此需要评估其实际探测能力及关键影响因素。
AI.method: 在EAC1设计下模拟HWO高分辨率成像仪2000秒曝光，假设源结构已知并忽略透镜星系光。利用弧信号信噪比和相对梯度功率从965个透镜中预选前50及前12个，评估不同质量阈值下的10%孔径覆盖率。通过非线性拟合验证Fisher预测，并测试波前误差从35到65 nm RMS变化、PSF建模正确与误匹配对探测能力的影响。
AI.result: 预选前50（5.2%）透镜使10%孔径覆盖的中位质量阈值较全样本降低约十倍；前12（1.2%）达到中位6.6×10^7太阳质量。在最敏感位置，前50和前12的中位阈值分别为3×10^7和1.5×10^7太阳质量。非线性拟合支持Fisher预测。波前误差从35增至65 nm RMS且PSF建模正确时，中位阈值仅上升0.1 dex；但故意误匹配35 nm参考PSF会消除可探测位置，假探测仍罕见。敏感性区域损失对应的可容忍波前失配中位为5 nm RMS（范围2–10 nm）。
AI.conclusion: 对Euclid或Roman发现的透镜进行选择性HWO跟踪观测，有望革新对暗物质本质的理解，但前提是PSF必须被足够精确地表征以保持这种探测灵敏度。

artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：对Euclid或Roman发现的透镜进行选择性HWO跟踪观测，有望革新对暗物质本质的理解，但前提是PSF必须被足够精确地表征以保持这种探测灵敏度。

title: Inferring magnetic field strengths in high-redshift lensing galaxies from Faraday rotation measure observations
summary: Observations of Faraday rotation in the lensing galaxy of CLASS B1152+199 at z = 0.439 suggest that efficient dynamo mechanisms had already amplified galactic magnetic fields by this epoch. We assess the reliability of this method for deriving magnetic field strengths and the likelihood of observing similarly large Faraday rotation differences. We select 64 star-forming disk galaxies from the TNG50 cosmological magnetohydrodynamical simulation, matched to CLASS B1152+199 in mass and redshift, and forward model them using polarized radiative transfer with POLARIS and subsequent RM synthesis. TNG50 predicts characteristic large-scale field strengths of B$_0$ = 1.9-15.6 $μ$G for individual galaxies, while the combined sample yields B$_0$ = 10.3 $μ$G. Field strengths B$_{obs}$ inferred from the synthetic observations generally recover B$_0$ within a factor of three. B$_{obs}$ depends only weakly on the assumed magnetic field geometry, whereas galaxy inclination and beam depolarization have stronger effects. The differential rotation measure recovered from RM synthesis remains correlated with the directly integrated value, although beam depolarization systematically reduces its magnitude. Only 1.41% of directly integrated sightline pairs reproduce the observed $Δ$RM = 1040 $\pm$ 60 rad m$^{-2}$ of CLASS B1152+199, increasing to 3.16% for sightlines at galactocentric distances comparable to the observed 2.6 and 6.5 kpc. Differential Faraday rotation of gravitationally lensed sources therefore provides a robust probe of large-scale magnetic fields, while the large $Δ$RM of CLASS B1152+199 is relatively rare among the considered TNG50 analog galaxies.

AI.tldr: 通过TNG50模拟与偏振辐射转移（POLARIS+RM合成）检验引力透镜法拉第旋转测量星系磁场的可靠性，发现该方法能较好恢复大尺度磁场强度（约三倍以内），但CLASS B1152+199观测到的大ΔRM在模拟样本中较为罕见。
AI.motivation: CLASS B1152+199透镜星系在z=0.439观测到的法拉第旋转暗示该时期星系磁场已被高效发电机机制放大，需要评估这一方法的可靠性以及观测到大法拉第旋转差的概率。
AI.method: 从TNG50宇宙磁流体模拟中选取64个在质量和红移上与CLASS B1152+199匹配的恒星形成盘星系，用POLARIS进行偏振辐射转移前向建模，再通过RM合成分析，并统计视线对的差分旋转测度。
AI.result: TNG50预测单星系大尺度场强B0=1.9–15.6 μG，样本合计B0=10.3 μG；由合成观测推断的Bobs通常在B0三倍以内恢复，其对磁场几何依赖较弱，而星系倾角和波束退偏振影响更强；RM合成得到的差分RM仍与直接积分值相关但被系统性压低；仅1.41%的视线对能复现ΔRM=1040±60 rad m⁻²，在2.6和6.5 kpc银心距处升至3.16%。
AI.conclusion: 引力透镜源的差分法拉第旋转是探测大尺度磁场的稳健方法，但CLASS B1152+199的大ΔRM在所考虑的TNG50类比星系中相对罕见。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 对z = 0.439的CLASS B1152+199透镜星系中法拉第旋转的观测表明，高效的发电机机制在这个时期已经放大了星系磁场。我们评估了这种方法推导磁场强度的可靠性以及观测到类似大的法拉第旋转差异的可能性。我们从TNG50宇宙磁流体动力学模拟中选择了64个恒星形成盘星系，在质量和红移上与CLASS B1152+199匹配，并使用POLARIS进行偏振辐射传输正向建模，随后进行RM合成。TNG50预测单个星系的特征大尺度场强为B$_0$ = 1.9-15.6 $μ$G，而组合样本给出B$_0$ = 10.3 $μ$G。从合成观测推断的场强B$_{obs}$通常在三倍以内恢复B$_0$。B$_{obs}$仅弱依赖于假设的磁场几何，而星系倾角和波束退偏振具有更强的影响。从RM合成恢复的差分旋转测度仍然与直接积分值相关，尽管波束退偏振系统地减小了其幅度。只有1.41%的直接积分视线对重现了CLASS B1152+199观测到的$Δ$RM = 1040 $\pm$ 60 rad m$^{-2}$，对于与观测到的2.6和6.5 kpc相当的星系中心距离的视线，这一比例增加到3.16%。因此，引力透镜源的差分法拉第旋转为探测大尺度磁场提供了稳健的探针，而CLASS B1152+199的大$Δ$RM在所考虑的TNG50类比星系中相对罕见。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：引力透镜源的差分法拉第旋转是探测大尺度磁场的稳健方法，但CLASS B1152+199的大ΔRM在所考虑的TNG50类比星系中相对罕见。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Left panel: Face-on map of the gas column density \(N_{{H}}\) of the exemplary lensing galaxy ID-1026 with a redshift of \(z=0.4\) from our TNG50 simulation sample. The red dot marks the peak value of \(N_{{H}}\) , and the green dot indicates the true offset position of a fictitious lensed galaxy behind. Purple and pink diamonds represent the corresponding positive (LP (+) ) and negative (LP (-) ) solutions of the lensing equation for the background galaxy. White circles indicate the considered beam sizes in arcseconds. Midle panel: The same as the left panel, but for the magnetic field in the disk averaged along the line of sight (LOS). title: A multi-scale view of molecular gas and magnetic fields in the Antennae galaxies
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures (Submitted to Astronomy & Astrophysics, comments welcome)
summary: Major mergers are transformative events in galaxy evolution, dynamically reshaping the stellar and gas makeup of the hosts, as well as the galaxy-scale magnetic fields (B-fields) that permeate their interstellar medium (ISM), altering both B-field strength and configuration. In this work, we study in detail the link between the co-evolving gas and B-fields in the cold ISM phase of the nearby Antennae galaxy merger (NGC 4038/4039), using CO(3-2) data from the LAsMA receiver at the APEX telescope and ALMA, together with archival 154 $μ$m dust polarization data from the SOFIA/HAWC+. We characterize trends between measurements of molecular gas intensity and velocity dispersion with polarization measurements at kpc-scales with the APEX and SOFIA data. We find anti-correlations with CO intensity ($ρ\lesssim-0.6$) and CO velocity dispersion ($ρ\lesssim-0.4$), which are signposts of geometric depolarization. Since dust polarization measurements are a density-weighted line-of-sight integrated average of B-field vectors below the beam size, the ALMA data can serve as a proxy of density structures below the SOFIA beam on a channel-by-channel basis. Through a geometric analysis of structures in the ALMA channels, we identify salient kinematic features in the overlap region strongly aligned with the SOFIA-inferred B-field orientation. This indicates that these kinematic features might dominantly lend their orientation to the measured field direction, assuming a correspondence between molecular gas structures and galactic B-fields, owing to their density or high polarization fraction. We also identify a modest trend ($ρ\sim0.5$) between the coherence of the molecular gas, a proxy of the line-of-sight angular dispersion, at small scales, and the SOFIA polarization fraction, showing that the polarization fraction measured at $\sim2$ kpc scales is sensitive to structures at $\sim50$ pc scales.

AI.tldr: 利用APEX/ALMA的CO(3-2)与SOFIA/HAWC+的154 μm尘埃偏振数据，研究近邻天线星系并合中冷ISM相气体与磁场B-field的共同演化关系，发现CO强度与速度色散同偏振度呈反相关（几何去偏振），并揭示小尺度气体结构与kpc尺度偏振的联系。
AI.motivation: 重大并合会重塑宿主星系的恒星、气体组成以及星际介质中的星系尺度磁场（强度与构型）。作者希望深入理解并合过程中冷ISM相内气体与磁场的共同演化关联，检验几何去偏振效应，并探讨分子气体结构与星系磁场之间的对应关系。
AI.method: 使用APEX望远镜LAsMA接收机及ALMA的CO(3-2)数据，结合SOFIA/HAWC+档案154 μm尘埃偏振数据，研究近邻天线星系并合（NGC 4038/4039）。在kpc尺度上对比分子气体强度、速度色散与偏振测量，并利用ALMA通道数据作为SOFIA波束内密度结构的代理，对ALMA通道中的结构做几何分析以识别与SOFIA推断B场方向对齐的运动学特征。
AI.result: 发现CO强度（ρ≲-0.6）与CO速度色散（ρ≲-0.4）同偏振测量之间存在反相关，是几何去偏振的标志。在重叠区识别出显著的运动学特征，其取向与SOFIA推断的B场方向强烈对齐，表明这些结构可能主导了所测磁场方向。还发现小尺度分子气体相干性（视向角色散代理）与SOFIA偏振度之间存在中等正相关（ρ~0.5），说明约2 kpc尺度的偏振度对约50 pc尺度结构敏感。
AI.conclusion: 几何去偏振在天线星系并合的冷ISM中显著存在；重叠区的运动学结构可能主要决定了测量到的B场方向；kpc尺度偏振度对小尺度（~50 pc）气体结构敏感，表明分子气体结构与星系磁场之间存在关联。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 重大并合是星系演化中的变革性事件，会动态重塑宿主星系的恒星和气体组成，以及渗透在其星际介质（ISM）中的星系尺度磁场（B场），改变B场强度和构型。在本工作中，我们利用APEX望远镜上的LAsMA接收器和ALMA的CO(3-2)数据，以及SOFIA/HAWC+的档案154 $μ$m尘埃偏振数据，详细研究了附近天线星系并合体（NGC 4038/4039）冷ISM相中共同演化的气体和B场之间的联系。我们利用APEX和SOFIA数据，在kpc尺度上表征了分子气体强度和速度色散测量值与偏振测量值之间的趋势。我们发现与CO强度（$ρ\lesssim-0.6$）和CO速度色散（$ρ\lesssim-0.4$）呈反相关，这是几何去偏振的标志。由于尘埃偏振测量是束大小以下B场矢量的密度加权视线积分平均，ALMA数据可以作为SOFIA束以下密度结构的代理，逐通道进行分析。通过对ALMA通道中结构的几何分析，我们识别出重叠区域中与SOFIA推断的B场方向强烈对齐的显著运动学特征。这表明，假设分子气体结构与星系B场之间存在对应关系，这些运动学特征可能主要将其方向借给测量到的场方向，这是由于它们的密度或高偏振度。我们还发现小尺度上分子气体的相干性（视线角分散的代理）与SOFIA偏振度之间存在适度的趋势（$ρ\sim0.5$），表明在$\sim2$ kpc尺度上测量的偏振度对$\sim50$ pc尺度的结构敏感。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：几何去偏振在天线星系并合的冷ISM中显著存在；重叠区的运动学结构可能主要决定了测量到的B场方向；kpc尺度偏振度对小尺度（~50 pc）气体结构敏感，表明分子气体结构与星系磁场之间存在关联。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Overview of data used in this work. The first column shows (a) the HAWC+ Stokes \(I\) intensity, (b) the polarized intensity, and (c) an RGB Hubble image constructed from the 435 nm, 550 nm, and 814 nm WFPC2 filters from top to bottom, respectively. Each plot shows the outline of the APEX integrated intensity map. The Stokes \(I\) map is overlaid with polarization vectors from HAWC+ rotated by 90 ∘ to show the local field orientation, scaled to the degree of polarization. The vectors have been rescaled to the square root of the polarization fraction for visualization purposes. The Hubble image is overlaid with the hexagonal apertures used in our analysis of SOFIA and APEX measurements, colored according to the region they are assigned to, including the tidal tails (black), the relic northern spiral arm (blue), the overlap region (red), the southern galaxy (NGC 4039) (green), and the northern galaxy (NGC 4038) core (orange). The second column shows (d) the integrated intensity, (e) first moment, and (f) velocity dispersion map derived from APEX. The third column shows (g) the integrated intensity, (h) first moment, and (i) velocity dispersion map of the ALMA data. Each plot includes an outline of the APEX integrated intensity map.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：本工作中使用的数据概览。第一列从上到下分别显示(a) HAWC+ Stokes \(I\) 强度，(b) 偏振强度，以及(c) 由435 nm、550 nm和814 nm WFPC2滤光片构建的RGB哈勃图像。每个图都显示了APEX积分强度图的轮廓。Stokes \(I\) 图叠加了来自HAWC+的偏振矢量，旋转90°以显示局部场方向，并按偏振度缩放。为了可视化目的，矢量已重新缩放到偏振度的平方根。哈勃图像叠加了用于分析SOFIA和APEX测量的六边形孔径，根据它们分配到的区域着色，包括潮汐尾（黑色）、遗迹北旋臂（蓝色）、重叠区（红色）、南星系（NGC 4039）（绿色）和北星系（NGC 4038）核心（橙色）。第二列显示(d)积分强度，(e)一阶矩，和(f)从APEX导出的速度色散图。第三列显示(g)积分强度，(h)一阶矩，和(i) ALMA数据的速度色散图。每个图都包括APEX积分强度图的轮廓。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Molecular gas measurements from APEX versus polarization quantities from SOFIA for the relic spiral arm, the overlap region, and the tidal tails. From top to bottom, the left column shows \(p\) , \(PI\) , \(I_{FIR}\) vs \(I_{CO}\) , the middle column shows \(p\) , \(PI\) , \(I_{FIR}\) vs \(\sigma_{CO}\) , and the right column shows \(p\) vs \(T_{dust}\) , \(N_{HI-H_{2}}\) , and \(I_{CO}\) vs \(\sigma_{CO}\) . Each data point represents a measurement performed from a single hexagonal aperture from the grid shown in Fig. 1 c. The color indicates the corresponding region in the galaxy merger: red for the overlap region, blue for the northern relic spiral arm, and black for the tidal tails. The relations are fit independently for each region using a linear fit, and the best-fit relations are plotted with their 1 \(\sigma\) uncertainty. The derived slope and correlation coefficient for each fit are reported in the legends and are calculated accounting for errors in both variables using the linmix package.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：遗迹旋臂、重叠区和潮汐尾的APEX分子气体测量值与SOFIA偏振量对比。从上到下，左列显示 \(p\) 、 \(PI\) 、 \(I_{FIR}\) 与 \(I_{CO}\) 的关系，中列显示 \(p\) 、 \(PI\) 、 \(I_{FIR}\) 与 \(\sigma_{CO}\) 的关系，右列显示 \(p\) 与 \(T_{dust}\) 、 \(N_{HI-H_{2}}\) 的关系，以及 \(I_{CO}\) 与 \(\sigma_{CO}\) 的关系。每个数据点代表从图1c所示网格中的单个六边形孔径进行的测量。颜色表示星系并合体中对应的区域：红色为重叠区，蓝色为北遗迹旋臂，黑色为潮汐尾。使用线性拟合对每个区域独立拟合关系，并绘制最佳拟合关系及其1 \(\sigma\) 不确定性。每个拟合的斜率和相关系数在图例中报告，并使用linmix包计算，同时考虑了两个变量的误差。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Example application of the Rolling Hough Transform on the \(v=+4\) km s -1 channel. ( Left column ) ALMA CO(3-2) intensity emission in the selected velocity channel, after masking. ( Right column ) RHT-derived angles for the same channel. The top row shows the intensity and angles for the whole galaxy, while the bottom row zooms in on the core of the northern galaxy NGC 4038. The RHT is applied on the masked CO channel to avoid spurious features. The red hexagons mark apertures that are included for the comparison between APEX and SOFIA data, but are excluded for the ALMA analysis due to no overlap with the ALMA integrated intensity map.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：在 \(v=+4\) km s -1 通道上应用滚动霍夫变换的示例。（左列）掩膜后选定速度通道中的ALMA CO(3-2)强度发射。（右列）同一通道的RHT导出角度。顶行显示整个星系的强度和角度，底行放大北星系NGC 4038的核心。RHT应用于掩膜后的CO通道以避免虚假特征。红色六边形标记了用于APEX和SOFIA数据比较的孔径，但由于与ALMA积分强度图没有重叠，在ALMA分析中被排除。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Maps showing for each aperture, ( Left ) the alignment between CO emission and B-fields ( \(\zeta\) ) obtained at \(v_{best}\) , ( Middle ) the velocity of best alignment, and ( Right ) the best alignment velocity with respect to the peak-intensity velocity of the aperture-integrated CO spectrum. In the plots, the white vectors show the directions of the dust polarization vectors rotated by 90 ∘ to show the B-field direction, while the purple vectors show the intensity-weighted orientation of the gas, at the best aligned channel for each aperture. The hexagons outlined in green (G1) and yellow (G2) show groups harboring similar \(v_{best}\) s, but which are kinematically distinct from each other, i.e. the G1 is blue-shifted w.r.t. the G2. The cyan ellipses mark the positions of filamentary structures identified in ALMA CO(3–2) data by Whitmore et al. (2014) .
figures.caption_zh: 图4：每个孔径的图显示（左）在 \(v_{best}\) 处获得的CO发射与B场之间的对齐（ \(\zeta\) ），（中）最佳对齐速度，以及（右）相对于孔径积分CO光谱的峰值强度速度的最佳对齐速度。在图中，白色矢量显示尘埃偏振矢量旋转90°以显示B场方向，而紫色矢量显示每个孔径最佳对齐通道中气体的强度加权方向。绿色（G1）和黄色（G2）轮廓的六边形显示具有相似 \(v_{best}\) 但运动学上彼此不同的组，即G1相对于G2蓝移。青色椭圆标记了Whitmore等人（2014）在ALMA CO(3–2)数据中识别的纤维状结构的位置。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Alignment of groups in the overlap region as a function of velocity. Each plot shows the degree of alignment \(\zeta\) as filled colors, and shows the SOFIA/HAWC+ polarization vectors rotated by 90 ∘ to show the B-field direction in white, and intensity-weighted orientation in each aperture for the channel. The green (G1) and yellow (G2) groups are kinematically distinct groups identified in the overlap region, which is shown in this figure. At \(v=+4\) km s -1 , G1 shows excellent alignment, while G2 does not yet contain significant emission. At \(v=-166\) km s -1 G1 is poorly aligned with the molecular gas, while G2 now aligns with the gas. At an intermediate velocity \(v=-76\) km s -1 we see neither group being well aligned with the gas structures at the associated velocity, showing that the alignment does not trivially improve with the presence of CO emission.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：重叠区中各组对齐随速度的变化。每个图显示对齐度 \(\zeta\) 作为填充颜色，并显示SOFIA/HAWC+偏振矢量旋转90°以显示B场方向（白色），以及每个孔径中该通道的强度加权方向。绿色（G1）和黄色（G2）组是在重叠区中识别的运动学上不同的组，如图所示。在 \(v=+4\) km s -1 处，G1显示出极好的对齐，而G2尚未包含显著发射。在 \(v=-166\) km s -1 处，G1与分子气体对齐较差，而G2现在与气体对齐。在中间速度 \(v=-76\) km s -1 处，我们看到两组在相关速度下都没有与气体结构很好地对齐，表明对齐不会随着CO发射的存在而简单地改善。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Coherence of CO structures, calculated for apertures with a filling fraction of atleast 15% (excluded marked in red). ( Left ) Map of \(t_{CO}\) measuring angular variance along the line-of-sight obtained from the RHT analysis. The white vectors show proportional to the degree of polarization in the inferred direction of the B-field, while the purple vectors show the intensity-weighted orientation of CO structures at the \(v_{best}\) of the apertures. Both quantities are calculated at the scale of the apertures. The beams of the SOFIA (gold) and ALMA (blue) data are shown in the bottom left, highlighting the difference in scales. ( Right ) Scatter plot of the measured \(t_{CO}\) and degree of polarization \(p\) with uncertainties. The correlation coefficient \(\rho\) was computed using the linmix package. The salmon lines show samples from the posterior distribution of the linear fit.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：CO结构的相干性，针对填充率至少为15%的孔径计算（排除的用红色标记）。（左）测量沿视线角方差的 \(t_{CO}\) 图，从RHT分析获得。白色矢量显示与偏振度成比例，方向为推断的B场方向，而紫色矢量显示在孔径的 \(v_{best}\) 处CO结构的强度加权方向。两个量都在孔径尺度上计算。SOFIA（金色）和ALMA（蓝色）数据的波束显示在左下角，突出了尺度差异。（右）测量的 \(t_{CO}\) 和偏振度 \(p\) 的散点图，带有不确定性。相关系数 \(\rho\) 使用linmix包计算。鲑鱼色线显示线性拟合后验分布的样本。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: No clear evidence of outflows in the high \(\sigma_{CO}\) feature. ( Left ) APEX moment-2 map showing the beam-sized apertures as blue circles along the high velocity dispersion feature in which corresponding spectra are calculated. The X’s mark the centers of both galaxies. ( Right ) Peak-normalized integrated spectra of the apertures from APEX (black) and ALMA (blue) CO(3–2) data. The gap in the APEX spectra are channels contaminated with an atmospheric ozone emission line, which we masked in the data reduction.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：没有明确证据表明高 \(\sigma_{CO}\) 特征中存在外流。（左）APEX二阶矩图，显示沿高速度色散特征的波束大小孔径为蓝色圆圈，其中计算了相应的光谱。X标记两个星系的中心。（右）来自APEX（黑色）和ALMA（蓝色）CO(3–2)数据的孔径的峰值归一化积分光谱。APEX光谱中的间隙是被大气臭氧发射线污染的通道，我们在数据还原中对其进行了掩膜。

figures.caption_en: Figure 8: Effect of smoothing on coherence maps and \(t_{CO}\) - \(p_{hex}\) correlation. ( Top row ) Coherence maps at 0.5 ′′ , 2 ′′ , 8 ′′ , 15 ′′ , calculated from smoothed \(U_{CO}\) and \(Q_{CO}\) maps. The colormaps of each plot are scaled to the same \(t_{CO}\) values for visualization. Beam sizes of each map are shown in blue in the bottom left. ( Bottom row ) Correlation of \(t_{CO}\) and \(p_{hex}\) at different resolutions. \(t_{CO}\) values were calculated for the same hexagonal aperture grid used throughout the work using \(U_{CO}\) and \(Q_{CO}\) values in each aperture. The salmon lines sample the posterior distribution of the fit correlation coefficient, using linmix_err .
figures.caption_zh: 图8：平滑对相干性图和 \(t_{CO}\) - \(p_{hex}\) 相关性的影响。（顶行）在0.5 ′′ 、2 ′′ 、8 ′′ 、15 ′′ 处从平滑的 \(U_{CO}\) 和 \(Q_{CO}\) 图计算的相干性图。每个图的颜色映射缩放到相同的 \(t_{CO}\) 值以便可视化。每个图的波束大小以蓝色显示在左下角。（底行）不同分辨率下 \(t_{CO}\) 和 \(p_{hex}\) 的相关性。 \(t_{CO}\) 值使用每个孔径中的 \(U_{CO}\) 和 \(Q_{CO}\) 值，针对整个工作中使用的相同六边形孔径网格计算。鲑鱼色线采样了拟合相关系数的后验分布，使用linmix_err。

title: The Largest Catalog of Dwarf Galaxy Groups: Transient Structures or Building Blocks of the Universe?
summary: Elusive dwarf galaxy groups provide a rare opportunity to study hierarchical galaxy assembly at the lowest-mass scales, but whether such associations are gravitationally bound systems or transient configurations remains uncertain. We present the largest catalog of isolated dwarf galaxy groups, identified using the DESI Survey, comprising 74 systems with three to six members per group. The groups have a median line-of-sight velocity dispersion of $\sim53$ km s$^{-1}$ and a median crossing time of $\sim0.37$ Gyr. We find that stellar mass alone is generally insufficient to bind the observed configurations. On the other hand, when dark matter is included using independently inferred stellar-to-halo mass relations and NFW potentials, 69 of 74 systems ($93\%$) favor a bound interpretation after propagating observational and halo-model uncertainties. For the 69 bound-favored systems, dynamical-friction estimates indicate that substantial orbital decay within a Hubble time is plausible if their members retain significant dark-matter subhalos. Our results suggest that many of these groups are systems caught during the assembly of more massive descendants, representing some of the lowest-mass sites of ongoing hierarchical galaxy growth in the nearby Universe and accessible laboratories for a mode of assembly expected to have been prevalent at early cosmic epochs.

AI.tldr: 本文利用DESI巡天构建了迄今最大的孤立矮星系群目录（74个系统，每组3–6个成员），并检验其是否为引力束缚系统。
AI.motivation: 矮星系群是研究最低质量尺度上等级式星系并合的重要场所，但这类星系群究竟是引力束缚系统还是短暂的构型，此前仍不确定。
AI.method: 基于DESI巡天识别孤立矮星系群，测量其视向速度弥散与穿越时间；分别仅用恒星质量以及结合独立推断的恒星-晕质量关系和NFW势（含暗物质）来检验系统是否束缚，并传播观测与晕模型的不确定性；对束缚占优的系统进行动力学摩擦估计。
AI.result: 星系群速度弥散中位数约53 km/s，穿越时间中位数约0.37 Gyr；仅靠恒星质量一般不足以束缚这些构型，而引入暗物质后，74个系统中有69个（93%）在误差传播后倾向于束缚解释；对这69个系统，动力学摩擦估计表明若成员保留显著暗物质子晕，则在一个哈勃时间内可发生显著轨道衰减。
AI.conclusion: 许多此类星系群可能是更大质量后代星系并合过程中的中间系统，代表了近邻宇宙中仍在进行等级式星系增长的最低质量场所，也是研究早期宇宙普遍并合模式的理想实验室。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 难以捉摸的矮星系群为研究最低质量尺度上的等级式星系组装提供了难得的机会，但此类星系群究竟是引力束缚系统还是瞬态构型仍不确定。我们呈现了最大的孤立矮星系群目录，这些星系群是利用DESI巡天证认的，包含74个系统，每个星系群有三到六个成员。这些星系群的中位视向速度弥散为$\sim53$ km s$^{-1}$，中位穿越时间为$\sim0.37$ Gyr。我们发现，仅凭恒星质量通常不足以束缚所观测到的构型。另一方面，当利用独立推断的恒星-晕质量关系和NFW势引入暗物质时，在传播观测和晕模型不确定性后，74个系统中有69个（$93\%$）倾向于束缚解释。对于这69个倾向于束缚的系统，动力学摩擦估计表明，如果其成员保留显著的暗物质子晕，那么在哈勃时间内发生显著的轨道衰减是可能的。我们的结果表明，这些星系群中的许多是在更大质量后代星系组装过程中被捕获的系统，代表了近邻宇宙中正在进行的等级式星系增长的一些最低质量场所，并且是研究一种预期在早期宇宙时代普遍存在的组装模式的易达实验室。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：许多此类星系群可能是更大质量后代星系并合过程中的中间系统，代表了近邻宇宙中仍在进行等级式星系增长的最低质量场所，也是研究早期宇宙普遍并合模式的理想实验室。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Top: Line-of-sight velocity offset from the group median versus projected distance from the group’s mass-weighted centroid, with points colored by the four-tier Monte Carlo bound classification (Section III.4 ). Middle: Distribution of crossing times relative to the Hubble time at each group’s redshift. Bottom: Group dynamical mass versus total stellar mass, colored by the same four-tier classification as the top panel.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：上：相对于星系群中位值的视向速度偏移与距星系群质量加权质心的投影距离的关系，点按四级蒙特卡洛束缚分类着色（第III.4节）。中：穿越时间相对于各星系群红移处哈勃时间的分布。下：星系群动力学质量与总恒星质量的关系，按与上图相同的四级分类着色。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Three tests of gravitational boundedness. Top: Stellar-mass-only virial ratio \(Q_{\star}=2T_{LOS,\star}/|U_{proj,\star}|\) ; only 15/74 groups (blue) satisfy \(Q_{\star}<2\) . Middle: Per-member velocity offsets normalized by the NFW-based escape velocity. Once halo mass is included, all but 7 members (4 groups) fall within the bound envelope. Bottom: Monte Carlo-propagated bound probability \(P_{bound}\) , incorporating velocity, stellar mass, and SHMR/concentration uncertainties; 66/74 groups (89%) are robustly bound at \(\geq\) 95% confidence.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：引力束缚性的三项检验。上：仅恒星质量的维里比 \(Q_{\star}=2T_{LOS,\star}/|U_{proj,\star}|\) ；只有15/74个星系群（蓝色）满足 \(Q_{\star}<2\) 。中：按基于NFW的逃逸速度归一化的每个成员速度偏移。一旦纳入晕质量，除7个成员（4个星系群）外，其余均落在束缚包络内。下：蒙特卡洛传播的束缚概率 \(P_{bound}\) ，纳入了速度、恒星质量和SHMR/浓度不确定性；66/74个星系群（89%）在 \(\geq\) 95%置信度下稳健束缚。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Merger timescale for the 69 bound-consistent groups ( \(P_{bound}\geq 0.68\) ), comparing the stellar-mass-only and SHMR-based halo-mass dynamical friction estimates. For each group, the plotted timescale is that of its slowest-sinking satellite, normalized by the Hubble time at the group’s redshift. Under the halo-mass assumption, all 69 groups (100%) fall below \(t_{merge}/t_{H}=1\) (horizontal red dashed line), indicating each is expected to fully coalesce into a single galaxy within a Hubble time. Under the stellar-mass-only assumption, only 20/69 groups (green) satisfy this criterion (vertical red dashed line).
figures.caption_zh: 图3：69个束缚一致星系群（ \(P_{bound}\geq 0.68\) ）的并合时标，比较了仅恒星质量和基于SHMR的晕质量动力学摩擦估计。对于每个星系群，所绘时标是其下沉最慢的卫星的时标，并按该星系群红移处的哈勃时间归一化。在晕质量假设下，所有69个星系群（100%）都低于 \(t_{merge}/t_{H}=1\) （水平红色虚线），表明每个星系群预计都会在一个哈勃时间内完全并合为单个星系。在仅恒星质量假设下，只有20/69个星系群（绿色）满足这一标准（垂直红色虚线）。
